name: Orazca
description: Orazca is the legendary golden city hidden in Ixalan's jungles, built by the Sun Empire around the Immortal Sun and now the Sun Empire's capital.

description_citations.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Orazca is the legendary golden city hidden in Ixalan's jungles, built by the Sun Empire around the Immortal Sun and now the Sun Empire's capital.

bio.text: The Sun Empire built Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misused it, and Azor made the empire leave the hidden city.

citations.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Orazca", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The River Heralds took the city and guarded it, and Azor sealed himself inside with the Immortal Sun.

citations.text: "Itlimoc". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: When Huatli was sent to find it and the Legion of Dusk, the Brazen Coalition and the River Heralds all raced for its secret, Orazca rose from the jungle.

citations.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.
"Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

bio.text: Kumena awakened the city, was thrown from the tower by Vona, and the factions fought over the Immortal Sun inside.

citations.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Azor revealed the Sun was the lock of his prison meant for Bolas, and Vraska then used Bolas's spell so that Tezzeret pulled the Immortal Sun away through a portal.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: With the Sun gone and the planar seal broken, the Legion retreated, the Coalition scattered, and Apatzec declared Orazca the Sun Empire's again.

citations.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion Orazca sealed itself, fighting broke out underground with trapped sleeper agents, and Huatli called the elder dinosaurs to drive the Phyrexians out.

citations.text: "Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Orazca", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Afterward Orazca was revived as the new capital and refuge for the displaced, and new chambers were found below it.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Orazca stands as the Sun Empire's capital, where the court plots over the boy-emperor and Huatli and Quintorius have opened the puzzle-door to the underground world.

citations.text: "Sun Empire", section "Rebuilding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli's planeswalker spark ignites; she glimpses a golden city before being pulled back, with the planeswalker sigil appearing above her.
timeline.quote: It was a city that shone with the warmth of gold.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Inti she believes she saw Orazca.
timeline.quote: I think I saw Orazca.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Emperor Apatzec what she saw, and he declares it proof of her worthiness.
timeline.quote: What you saw is proof of your worthiness to hold that mantle.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Inti offers to accompany Huatli with Teyeuh, and Huatli admits she wants to find the city.
timeline.quote: I want to find the city.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kopala meditates in the Primal Wellspring with Tishana and feels the pulse of Orazca skip a beat.
timeline.quote: The pulse skips a beat.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Kopala the disturbance involves Orazca.
timeline.quote: And what involves Orazca involves the whole world,

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
timeline.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: At a tomb near Orazca they find Saint Elenda; Angrath strikes Huatli and goes on alone, and she sends a Dinosaur to trample him.
timeline.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reach Azor in his sanctum in Orazca; he reveals he never received Ugin's signal.
timeline.quote: but that he had never received Ugin's signal to activate the sun and draw the evil dragon to the plane.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace stops Vraska from killing Azor and, as the Living Guildpact, sentences him to solitude on Useless Island.
timeline.quote: but Jace stopped her.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Coalition reaches Orazca seeking the Immortal Sun but fails to secure it.
timeline.quote: They reached the Golden City Orazca

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli is proclaimed warrior-poet and tasked to reclaim the Golden City.
timeline.quote: Huatli was proclaimed warrior-poet of the Empire and tasked by the Emperor to reclaim the Golden City for the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret stole the Immortal Sun through a planar portal

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misuses it, and Azor makes the Empire leave the hidden city.
timeline.quote: As a consequence, Azor caused the Empire to leave the city.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire takes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk to the sea; Fort Leor falls.
timeline.quote: After the Sun Empire took Orazca and pushed the Legion of Dusk to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the invasion the Sun Empire moves its capital back to Orazca and begins a campaign to invade Torrezon using reverse-engineered ships.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire moved its capital back to Orazca

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas, breaking the barrier.
timeline.quote: was stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back, then launches the Dawn Fleet toward Torrezon.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Orazca Malcolm's song paralyzes the combatants over the Immortal Sun, letting Breeches stop Vona from killing Huatli.
timeline.quote: Malcolm used his song to paralyze Huatli , Tishana , Vona , and Mavren Fein

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli is gifted the Immortal Sun and misuses it; the city is ruined and abandoned, and the Sun passes to the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: He wielded the artifact without any wisdom or restraint, and the city was ruined.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kumena rediscovers Orazca, reaches the Threefold Temple and awakens the city and its creatures.
timeline.quote: Kumena was the first person to reach the Golden City in centuries.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace meet Azor, who reveals Ixalan was meant to be Bolas's prison; they plan to infiltrate Bolas's organization.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace hatched a plan to infiltrate Bolas' organization

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska uses Bolas's spell and Tezzeret seizes the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: Vraska used the spell taught to her by Bolas, resulting in the Sun being seized through a planar portal by Tezzeret .

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, pirates and River Heralds depart; Apatzec Intli III claims the city and declares conquest of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: proclaimed a new age of conquest that would now target Torrezon

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orazca becomes the new heart of the Sun Empire and its population explodes.
timeline.quote: Its population exploded as migrants from across the empire streamed into the ancient metropolis

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chacanto Intli founds the Sun Empire from Orazca, uniting the city-states.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was first founded from Orazca by Chacanto Intli

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Orazca retaken, the empire pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea and prepares an invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: With Orazca retaken, the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "First expedition to Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Mavren Fein, Vona reaches Orazca and throws Kumena from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun and removes it from Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the artifact was stolen by Tezzeret and removed from the plane

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
timeline.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace theorizes the compass points to a specific kind of magical expression and that Orazca must be a massive hub of such energy.
timeline.quote: the Golden City would have to be a massive hub of magical energy

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
timeline.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
timeline.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
timeline.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: An earthquake shakes the clearing and Orazca begins rising from the jungle.
timeline.quote: The city itself was emerging from the jungle with every jostle of the earthquake.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Malcolm says someone must have arrived at the city first, and a great beast bellows.
timeline.quote: Someone must have arrived at the city first.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: The city opens like a flower in gold, turquoise, amber and jade.
timeline.quote: The city itself had opened like the petals of a flower.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace loses his grip on a boulder and tumbles down the waterfall as Vraska reaches for him.
timeline.quote: the ground jerked sideways once more, and Jace lost his grip.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska falls after Jace and is swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.
timeline.quote: Vraska was swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace is regaining all his memories and fears their friendship will dissolve.
timeline.quote: He would remember he was the Guildpact and she was an assassin and their friendship would certainly dissolve.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena climbs the great staircase and enters Orazca.
timeline.quote: Kumena ascended to the golden city at last.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A voice from the golden walls calls Kumena to set it free.
timeline.quote: Kumena the Shaper, child of the Great River, leader of your people. Come set me free.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena realizes the voice is his own reflected power.
timeline.quote: The voice was deep and commanding, the voice of a leader. It was his own.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The voice calls itself the Sun and tells Kumena to follow it through the labyrinth.
timeline.quote: I am the Sun, Kumena. As you will be.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the central tower and finds the Immortal Sun embedded in the floor.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the chamber, and beheld the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena steps onto the Immortal Sun and takes its power.
timeline.quote: Kumena stepped onto the Immortal Sun and took that power, his power.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena raises the city from the ground, opening a canyon around it and flooding it with rivers.
timeline.quote: He flexed his fingers, and the city lurched upward, separating from the rock around it.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena's laughter is cut short when Vona confronts him atop the Sun.
timeline.quote: Kumena turned his physical form, the one that stood atop the Immortal Sun, and locked eyes with a vampire.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein tackle Kumena and wound him.
timeline.quote: The vampires scratched and bit, and one of their swords sliced a long line into Kumena's side.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona throws Kumena out of the tower window.
timeline.quote: before Kumena could react, she threw him out the window.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace lies bleeding on the riverbank, his mind broadcasting memories.
timeline.quote: Jace lay in agony on the riverbank.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace's injury has left his mind unable to contain his memories.
timeline.quote: He broadcasted his memories now in bursts and stops, clearly trying to wrestle them back under control.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds the weeping Jace, the first time she has touched anyone willingly in years.
timeline.quote: Vraska instantly dove to the ground and scooped him into her arms.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace says Vraska saw everything and acknowledges she is an assassin; she answers she is also a friend.
timeline.quote: You're an assassin

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace says his memory is not fully back and has gaps.
timeline.quote: It's not all back. There are gaps.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska for trying to kill him.
timeline.quote: I forgive you for trying to kill me,

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass, which points straight at the central tower.
timeline.quote: its light pointed an arrow-straight line toward the tower.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace says the last three months were the best of his life.
timeline.quote: It was the best three months of my life.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace the person who listened to her is who he really is.
timeline.quote: That Jace is still in you, and I think that Jace is who you really are.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace speaks of his mother wanting him to be a scholar.
timeline.quote: My mother wanted me to move to the city to be a scholar.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska helps Jace up and they start to climb the staircase to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Vraska held out a hand to help Jace to his feet.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he used to be a coward as they climb.
timeline.quote: I used to be a coward.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
timeline.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the real city unlike the one in her vision.
timeline.quote: The city was more beautiful than she could possibly have imagined . . . and it looked nothing like the city she had seen in her vision.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
timeline.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
timeline.quote: was going to get there before she did.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs the golden stairs to Orazca, exhausted and in control of his memories.
timeline.quote: He deliberately placed each foot ahead of the other as he ascended the stairs to Orazca

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls trying to break into a golden dragon's mind and his own being erased (memory).
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into a dragon's mind.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace recalls Ugin bidding him farewell (memory).
timeline.quote: Good fortune, Jace Beleren

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass at the top of the stairs.
timeline.quote: What we need is in there.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A huge flying creature rises over Orazca while Jace hides them with an illusion.
timeline.quote: An immense dinosaur's head towered over the city.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: Malcolm, you heard Jace too?!

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: I'll call you Captain.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: It's a date.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.quote: How did I get here?

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath curses the plane and planeswalks away, free at last.
timeline.quote: SEE YOU NEVER, PATHETIC FOOLS!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes both the Immortal Sun and the barrier are gone.
timeline.quote: Both the Immortal Sun and the barrier.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is gone!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Breeches and Malcolm decide to run away.
timeline.quote: RUNNING AWAY!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

timeline.quote: No, my child. We are free. It is gone forever.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: My journey ended centuries ago, when I found this place.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona says they conquered Torrezon and built an empire in Elenda's honor.
timeline.quote: We conquered Torrezon,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: You must be the one to tell your story. Not them.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: Take me to Queen Miralda,

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
timeline.quote: Orazca is found

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana agrees the River Heralds are open to negotiation.
timeline.quote: Yes. The River Heralds are.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons an elder dinosaur through the city's power.
timeline.quote: The threefold roar of an elder dinosaur filled her ears, and Huatli smiled.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
timeline.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.quote: Jace had shrouded himself in invisibility as the Immortal Sun vanished

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.
